classification: implementation defect, not a design change
finding: MIN_DOC_SENTENCES was 1200, inconsistent with the frozen Batch 7
selection_v3.json). Left as it was, the builder acted as an unregistered
second selection stage: 15 of the 23 selected documents fall between 337
and 1098 usable sentences and would have been silently discarded, yielding
an 8-document corpus instead of the declared 23.
why_it_matters: The declared sample would no longer be the analysed sample, and the
document distribution would be silently reshaped. This is precisely the
silent rule shift between selection and build that Batch 7 exists to
detect, so the discrepancy was caught before any corpus was generated.
remediation: The builder was corrected to implement the frozen criterion. No
qualification rule changed, no threshold moved, no document was selected,
reordered, replaced or dropped, and no research question was touched.
guards_added: assert len(selected_documents) == 23, else abort before building
assert every selected document has usable_sentences >= 300, else abort
both guards raise SystemExit, so no partial corpus can be produced
prior_value_retained: The 1200 threshold is not deleted from the record; it is documented here
and in the module docstring and constant name as an implementation
verification: builder guard verified to abort on a 22-document input
